summary: The plan survives adversarial reconstruction. I independently rebuilt the occurrence set at 9725f16 for every withdrawn name (ProviderHandle, provider, observations, stations, provider_info, product_info, map_stations) plus CatalogSource and catalogue `source=`, and the plan's write-set is an exact match: 19 source files modified, handle.py deleted, 19 test files modified plus tests/_stubs/stub_provider.py, and 3 test files deleted. results.py is present, closing the gap the step-graph gate found. No breaking test file is unnamed, and the three files that grep-match but must not change (conftest.py via `_ProviderHandle`, test_pl_imgw_cache.py via a string literal, test_internal_provider_module.py via parameter-only narrowing) are each explicitly proven untouched or provably unaffected. All newly authored data is quoted verbatim and I verified each value against the ref: the 11-name sorted dir() list, the eight-name absence tuple, EXPECTED_PRODUCT_IDS/EXPECTED_PRODUCTS_BY_PROVIDER, `rr.products() == ["level"]` for the m1 stub registry, the ('live','cached') rejection inputs, and pr-body.md. Survivors are preserved with explicit regressions: products(provider=None) keeps its sorted canonical list semantics and its four keep-tests, map(selection) keeps its five tests with a renamed survival regression. Retained live machinery is correctly fenced (observation_source='live', read_live_native_rows, refresh_native_table_from_live, the --live route, their tests, and the live_* provider-info fields), and I confirmed no surviving public name reads those fields. RawMode publicness and fetch's raw=/on_issue= are untouched, correctly leaving those to m5. The offline wheel smoke is achievable: the wheel name is deterministic, --no-deps needs no index, and dist/ and .venv are gitignored so the status expectations hold. Reversibility is intact: no tag, no push, no version bump, no artifact regeneration, exactly one conventional commit after all six gates. The remaining discrepancies I measured are prose miscounts and dead-code judgement calls that cannot produce a divergent or red implementation, so they are recorded as notes rather than findings.
